title_sq: Okazion Kleringu!! Prane Ish Parkut, Tek Viva Residence, Shitet Apartament 2+1+2, Me Hapesira Te Bollshme !!
description_sq: Okazion Kleringu!! Prane Ish Parkut, Tek Viva Residence, Shitet Apartament 2+1+2, Me Hapesira Te Bollshme !! Apartamenti me siperfaqe bruto 126.2 m² , ndodhet ne katin e 6 dhe organizohet ne dhomen e ndenjes bashke me kendin e gatimit dhe dalje ne ballkon, dhoma matrimoniale me tualet me vete dhe ballkon, dhoma e gjumit te femijeve dhe tualeti dites . Apartamenti aktualisht eshte ne faze karabina te punimeve dhe pritet te perfundoje brenda 18 muajve. Zona ne te cilen ndodhet apartamenti ofron te gjitha facilitetet e nevojshme per nje jetese komode. Kompleksi ne te cilin ndodhet apartamenti dallohet per cilesine e punimeve dhe eshte nje nder komplekset me te mira te zones.
title_en: Clearing opportunity!! Near the former park, at Viva Residence, 2+1+2 apartment for sale, with plenty of space!!
description_en: Clearing opportunity!! Near the former park, at Viva Residence, 2+1+2 apartment for sale, with plenty of space!! The apartment with a gross area of ​​126.2 m², is located on the 6th floor and is organized in the living room with a kitchenette and access to the balcony, a matrimonial room with its own toilet and balcony, a children's bedroom and a day toilet. The apartment is currently in the early stages of construction and is expected to be completed within 18 months. The area in which the apartment is located offers all the necessary facilities for a comfortable life. The complex in which the apartment is located stands out for the quality of the works and is one of the best complexes in the area.
